name: Adaptive Raw Report
description: A broad content-neutral blueprint that adapts its analytical structure to the actual source and plan when no domain candidate is sufficiently confident.

guidance: Build sections from the actual subject and plan rather than a predefined domain taxonomy.
Keep charts optional and prefer insight grids, evidence lists, or process flows for qualitative structure.
End with synthesis, deficiencies, limitations, and evidence.

data_requirements.description: Materialize objective-relevant content or values with enough context and source lineage for deep analysis.
calculation_hints: Preserve substantive content and source locations.
Preserve values and dimensions needed for honest comparisons when present.
Do not replace subject evidence with structural counts.

fallback.message: Explain which objective-relevant evidence could not be materialized.

sections.title: Source and Content Overview
sections.purpose: Profile the source and immediately explain what it contains and why it matters.

blocks.title: Data Profile
instructions: Show file type, source size or record coverage, fields, and material missingness as a compact one-column profile.

blocks.title: Content Summary
instructions: Directly summarize the subject, purpose, major ideas, and objective-relevant answer in detailed prose.

blocks.title: Key Findings
instructions: Surface distinct findings; use numbers only when they carry analytical meaning.

sections.title: Deep Analysis
sections.purpose: Develop the most important themes, comparisons, mechanisms, or arguments found in the evidence.

blocks.title: Analytical Interpretation
instructions: Write several well-separated paragraphs that explain patterns, relationships, tensions, and context without repeating the overview.

blocks.title: How the Evidence Connects
instructions: Use a short ordered flow only when the evidence supports a mechanism, sequence, or dependency.

sections.title: Visual Evidence
sections.purpose: Use the most honest visual form to support the preceding analysis.

blocks.title: Evidence View

chart_slot.intent: Prove one material analytical claim with an honest quantitative comparison, distribution, relationship, or trend.

fallback.message: No quantitative visual would materially improve the analysis.

instructions: Omit this block if the available values do not prove a meaningful claim.

blocks.title: Evidence Trail
instructions: Connect findings to specific source locations, values, excerpts, or records.

sections.title: Synthesis, Evidence Gaps and Limitations
sections.purpose: Integrate the findings, explain their significance, and state what the evidence cannot establish.

blocks.title: Synthesis
instructions: Integrate the strongest findings into a final answer without merely recapping section headings.

blocks.title: Evidence-Based Actions
instructions: Offer conditional actions only when supported by the evidence; state rationale, prerequisite, risk, and a validation signal without inventing targets or owners.

blocks.title: Deficiencies and Limitations
instructions: State only real coverage, quality, extraction, method, or evidence limitations and distinguish unknowns from contradictions.
